summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, attaching its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026 and MD&A, along with certifications and a press release. The filing is a routine periodic report of a Canadian foreign private issuer, showing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or abrupt management change.
